question: What world and retinue are found in the principle of attachment?
premises: In the principle of attachment there is a world of the lord of heroes.
That world is a city of teachers and students.
Each has a retinue numbering ten million and sixteen thousand.
inference: The attachment principle contains the world of the lord of heroes, inhabited by teachers and students with vast retinues.
uncertainties: It is slightly ambiguous whether the count applies to each teacher-student pair or to each principal figure.
plain_english: In the principle of attachment is the world of the lord of heroes, a city of teachers and students. Each has a retinue of ten million and sixteen thousand.
